subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Carnal
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"carnal"** means relating to physical, especially sexual, needs and activities. (शारीरिक)

 
 
• **Example:** His thoughts were filled with** carnal **desires.
 
 
 
• **"Spiritual"** refers to relating to or affecting the human spirit or soul as opposed to material or physical things. (आध्यात्मिक)
 
 
• **Example:** She is more interested in **spiritual** matters than material possessions.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'carnal'** is **'spiritual'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Material** (भौतिक): Relating to physical objects or the body.

 
 
• **Example:** He was more interested in** material** wealth than spiritual enlightenment.
 
 
 
• **Temporal** (सांसारिक): Relating to worldly as opposed to spiritual affairs; secular.
 
 
• **Example:** The monk renounced his **temporal **possessions.
 
 
 
• **Somatic** (शारीरिक): Relating to the body, especially as distinct from the mind.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor focused on **somatic** symptoms rather than psychological ones.
